AMD Starts Shipping 256-Core Zen 6 EPYC Chips Built for the AI Agent Boom

AMD's sixth-generation EPYC SP7 processors are now generally available, with servers shipping and Meta lined up as lead customer. The company says agent workloads are driving the strongest early demand it has seen for a new EPYC generation.
